title: Corner C3 - Handoff Animation Design Spec
summary: When one agent hands work to another, you see it happen. Note icon, float path, pickup animation. The visual that sells transparency.
content:
Corner C3: Handoff Animation Design Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. This is the animation clients point at and say "I've never seen that before." Make it smooth, make it real.

The Concept

When Steffen hands a design spec to Bobby, a small note icon appears on Steffen's desk. The note lifts off, floats through the main hall (or the shortest path between rooms), and lands on Bobby's desk. Bobby looks at it, nods, picks it up. A toast notification fires. The quest log updates.

This is not a UI gimmick. This is work transparency made visible. The CPA sees their brief move from the strategy agent to the builder agent. They understand the pipeline without reading a status page.

Trigger

WebSocket event:

{
  "type": "handoff",
  "from_agent": "steffen",
  "to_agent": "bobby",
  "task": "Brand page v4 design specs",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-16T16:00:00Z"
}

Handoff Note Icon

Design

  • Shape: small folded document/note
  • Size: 12x14px at Level 2 zoom (scales with zoom)
  • Color: #FDF6EC (paper color) with a subtle fold shadow
  • Accent: 2px colored bar at the top edge in the SENDING agent's color (e.g., Steffen's gold #C9A84C)
  • Shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)

SVG Specification

<!-- Handoff note: 12x14px -->
<g class="handoff-note">
  <!-- Paper body -->
  <rect x="0" y="2" width="12" height="12" fill="#FDF6EC" rx="1"
    stroke="#D8D0C4" stroke-width="0.5" />
  <!-- Top color bar (sender's agentColor) -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="3" fill="{senderAgentColor}" rx="1 1 0 0" />
  <!-- Fold corner (top-right) -->
  <path d="M9,0 L12,3 L9,3 Z" fill="#D8D0C4" />
  <!-- Content lines (abstract) -->
  <line x1="2" y1="6" x2="10" y2="6" stroke="#B0A898" stroke-width="0.5" />
  <line x1="2" y1="8" x2="8" y2="8" stroke="#B0A898" stroke-width="0.5" />
  <line x1="2" y1="10" x2="9" y2="10" stroke="#B0A898" stroke-width="0.5" />
</g>

Animation Sequence

Phase 1: Appear (0ms - 300ms)

  • Note icon fades in on the sending agent's desk
  • Position: near the agent's hands (front of desk, center)
  • Scale: 0.0 -> 1.0 with spring easing (overshoot to 1.1 then settle)
  • Opacity: 0 -> 1 (200ms)
  • Sending agent enters "speaking" sprite state (if not already)

Phase 2: Lift Off (300ms - 600ms)

  • Note lifts from the desk surface
  • Y-axis: rises 8px above the desk (in SVG space)
  • Slight rotation: 0deg -> -5deg (tilts as if picked up)
  • Shadow darkens and separates: the drop shadow grows from 1px to 4px offset
  • A tiny sparkle/glint at the top of the note (2px white circle, opacity 0 -> 0.8 -> 0, 200ms)

Phase 3: Float (600ms - 2000ms)

The note travels from the sending room to the receiving room.

Path Calculation:

  • Use the adjacency map from gridSpec.js to find the shortest path between rooms
  • The note follows this path, moving through doorways/open walls
  • Path is rendered as a quadratic bezier curve (not a straight line)

Path Shape:

  • Start: center of sending room desk
  • End: center of receiving room desk
  • Control point: midpoint between rooms, elevated 20px above the straight line
  • This creates a gentle arc, like the note is being carried by an invisible hand

Float Animation:

  • Duration: ~1400ms for the float phase (varies by distance)
  • Easing: cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.0, 0.3, 1.0) (accelerates gently, decelerates at end)
  • The note rotates slowly during flight: -5deg -> 5deg -> 0deg (gentle wobble)
  • A faint trail: 3 smaller copies of the note at 20%, 10%, 5% opacity, 50ms behind each other (motion blur effect)
  • Trail fades as the note decelerates

When Crossing Rooms:

  • If the path goes through the Main Hall, the note is visible crossing the open space
  • If the path goes through a doorway (interior-door), the note briefly dims (80% opacity) as it passes through the wall, then brightens again
  • The note is always rendered at z-index 22 (above room floors, above furniture, below HUD)

Phase 4: Landing (2000ms - 2400ms)

  • Note decelerates as it approaches the receiving desk
  • Y-axis: descends from arc height back to desk level
  • Scale: 1.0 -> 0.95 -> 1.0 (slight compression on "landing")
  • Rotation settles to 0deg
  • Shadow returns to small (4px -> 1px offset)
  • Small "puff" effect: 4 tiny circles (2px, agentColor at 20%) burst outward from the landing point, 200ms, then fade

Phase 5: Pickup (2400ms - 3200ms)

  • Receiving agent enters "thinking" sprite state
  • After 200ms: agent "looks" at the note (head turns toward desk, if sprite supports it; otherwise skip)
  • After 400ms: agent enters "speaking" sprite state briefly (acknowledging)
  • After 600ms: note fades out (opacity 1 -> 0, 200ms, as if the agent absorbed it into their task list)
  • Simultaneously: new task appears in the receiving agent's Checklist (if Checklist mode is visible)
  • Receiving agent returns to normal state after 800ms

Phase 6: Notification (fires at Phase 4 start, 2000ms)

  • Toast notification: blue accent (handoff type)
  • Message: "[From Agent] handed off to [To Agent]: [task description]"
  • HUD: if task drawer is visible, new task card appears for receiving agent
  • Quest Log: if Megaboard is visible, new quest appears
  • Mini-map: brief flash on the receiving room's rectangle (agentColor at 50% for 300ms)

Multiple Simultaneous Handoffs

If multiple handoffs happen at once (e.g., Mom routing work to 3 agents):

  • Queue handoff animations: 500ms delay between each
  • First handoff starts immediately
  • Second starts at 500ms
  • Third starts at 1000ms
  • This creates a cascade effect that's visually clear, not chaotic

If the same agent sends multiple handoffs:

  • The first note lifts off
  • After 200ms, the second note appears on the desk
  • They fly in sequence toward different rooms

Handoff at Different Zoom Levels

Level 1 (Overview, 0.7x)

  • Note icon is small (6x7px) but visible against the dark rooms
  • The arc path is short on screen but still readable
  • Trail effect reduced (1 trail copy instead of 3)
  • This is the best zoom level for seeing handoffs across the entire office

Level 2 (Neighborhood, 1.6x)

  • Full animation with trail, sparkle, puff
  • Note is 12x14px, clearly readable
  • If the handoff is between visible rooms, full animation plays
  • If one room is off-screen, the note flies to the edge of the viewport with an arrow hint

Level 3 (Room Detail, 2.8x)

  • If the user is zoomed into the SENDING room: they see Phase 1-2 and the note leaving
  • If zoomed into the RECEIVING room: they see Phase 4-5 and the note arriving
  • The camera does NOT auto-zoom out for handoffs. The user chose this zoom level.
  • Instead: a mini-map flash indicates where the handoff went

Performance Considerations

  • The note is a single SVG group, not a DOM element (stays in the SVG layer)
  • The path is pre-calculated once per handoff event, not per frame
  • The trail is achieved with CSS opacity on cloned elements, not per-frame rendering
  • Maximum simultaneous animated notes: 3 (queue any beyond that)
  • Animation uses requestAnimationFrame, not CSS animation (for synchronization with SVG)

Sound (Optional, Off by Default)

  • Phase 1 (appear): subtle paper rustle sound, 100ms
  • Phase 3 (float): very quiet whoosh, peaks at midpoint, 300ms
  • Phase 4 (landing): soft paper tap, 100ms
  • All sounds at 20% volume, only if corner-sound-enabled is true in localStorage

The handoff animation is the single most differentiating visual in Corner. No other AI product shows work moving between agents in real-time. Make it silky. Bobby builds this in Step 8.
